enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Remains asleep. Occasionally shifts position. Continues sleeping.

Wakes up. Sits up. Gets out of bed. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Washes body. Washes hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel. Puts on clothes. Brushes teeth. Washes face. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1, listening to a podcast on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Greets Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Places ingredients on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl and utensils. Prepares breakfast. Uses toaster. Uses microwave. Sets table. Sits at table with Member 1. Picks up phone. Opens podcast app. Plays podcast. Eats breakfast. Drinks. Talks with Member 1. Finishes eating. Clears dishes. Washes dishes. Puts dishes away.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the desk workstation, checking emails and planning the day's tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom 2. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Turns on monitor. Adjusts chair. Sits down. Opens email client. Checks emails. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Reviews schedule. Opens task management app. Plans tasks. Makes to-do list. Updates calendar. Closes email. Opens work documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely on arts administration tasks - scheduling programs, budgets and correspondence on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Types on keyboard. Moves mouse. Opens scheduling software. Creates program schedule. Enters dates and times. Opens budget spreadsheet. Updates budget figures. Reviews expenses. Writes correspondence. Sends emails. Attends virtual meeting. Takes notes. Uses calculator. Saves files. Takes a break. Stretches. Resumes typing. Checks phone. Responds to message. Continues working.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 1, then tidying the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Greets Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Places ingredients on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out plates and utensils. Prepares lunch. Uses microwave. Sets table. Sits at table with Member 1. Eats lunch. Drinks. Talks with Member 1. Finishes eating. Clears dishes. Wipes counters. Washes dishes. Puts dishes away.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short afternoon walk around the neighborhood with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on shoes. Opens door. Walks outside. Walks with Member 1. Turns left. Walks along sidewalk. Crosses street. Continues walking. Talks with Member 1. Looks at surroundings. Turns around. Walks back. Opens door. Enters house. Takes off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work - sketching and coloring client commissions on the monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens illustration software. Creates new canvas. Sketches using mouse. Colors. Adjusts colors. Zooms in. Zooms out. Saves file. Opens reference images. Switches between windows. Takes breaks. Stretches. Continues working. Checks email. Responds to client. Sends draft. Closes software.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for tea and having a light snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Turns on kettle. Opens cabinet. Takes out mug. Takes out tea bag. Places tea bag in mug. Opens refrigerator. Takes out snack. Places snack on plate. Kettle boils. Pours hot water into mug. Adds milk. Takes mug and plate to table. Sits down. Drinks tea. Eats snack. Finishes. Washes mug and plate. Puts away.

enriched_activities.activity: Quick tidy-up of the living area using the vacuum cleaner
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Opens closet. Takes out vacuum cleaner. Plugs in vacuum cleaner. Turns on vacuum. Moves vacuum across floor. Vacuums under sofa. Vacuums corners. Turns off vacuum. Unplugs. Winds cord. Puts vacuum away. Adjusts cushions. Folds blankets. Wipes coffee table. Puts items away.

Walks to kitchen. Sits at table with Member 1. Serves food. Picks up fork. Eats. Drinks water. Talks with Member 1. Uses napkin. Passes dish to Member 1. Stands up to get more water. Sits back down. Continues eating. Finishes meal. Clears plates. Puts plates in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the dishes and loading the dishwasher with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Collects dishes from table. Scrapes food into bin. Rinses dishes. Opens dishwasher. Loads dishes into dishwasher. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Wipes counters. Sweeps floor. Takes out trash. Replaces trash bag. Washes hands. Dries hands.

Walks to living room. Sits on sofa with Member 1. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Selects program. Watches TV. Talks with Member 1. Adjusts volume. Gets up to get snack. Returns. Continues watching. Turns off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening walk to clear the head after a day at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on shoes. Opens door. Walks outside. Walks alone. Turns right. Walks along sidewalk. Crosses street. Continues walking. Looks at surroundings. Turns around. Walks back. Opens door. Enters house. Takes off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making final revisions to an illustration draft on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens illustration file. Reviews draft. Makes changes. Adjusts colors. Adds details. Saves file. Exports final version. Sends to client. Closes program. Turns off computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Washes body. Washes hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel. Puts on pajamas. Brushes teeth. Washes face. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down - reading and checking the phone under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom 2. Turns on desk lamp. Sits on bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Scrolls through apps. Puts down phone. Continues reading. Closes book. Turns off desk lamp. Lies down.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Falls asleep. Remains asleep.
